Highlight Clip: Justin Sun: AI and Quantum Risks Make Me More Bearish on Bitcoin Than Before Justin Sun: AI and Quantum Risks Make Me More Bearish on Bitcoin Than Before On October 16, 2026, Justin Sun said in an interview with William Joy that advances in AI algorithms and quantum computing risks had made him more bearish on Bitcoin than before. He argued that the industry and investors holding Bitcoin through ETFs had not fully priced in these risks. He also suggested that AI progress in mathematics could potentially enable classical computing to break existing cryptography, even before a quantum computing breakthrough. — link

Mt. Gox Delays Creditor Repayment Deadline to 2027 for Fourth Straight Year Mt. Gox, once the world's largest Bitcoin exchange before its collapse in 2014 following a major theft, has extended its creditor repayment deadline by another year to October 31, 2027, marking the fourth consecutive annual extension since 2023. Court-appointed rehabilitation trustee Nobuaki Kobayashi said repayments have largely been completed for creditors who fulfilled the required procedures without issues, but many remain unpaid due to incomplete documentation or processing problems. — link

ZachXBT: Over 87% of Inflows to FreedomXMR, a Laundering Service on Hyperliquid, Linked to Illicit Activity On-chain investigator ZachXBT reported that over 87% of inflows to FreedomXMR (FXMR), a centralized money laundering service that emerged on Hyperliquid Core in August 2026, are directly linked to illicit activity. A review of historical inflows exceeding $10,000 per transaction traced more than $20 million to ransomware, exploits, and social engineering attacks, including incidents involving DCENT Wallet, Fetch ai, Axelar, and Gamdom. The investigation also found that FXMR's administrator sourced XMR liquidity from KuCoin, with associated addresses making over 3,000 deposits to the exchange. ZachXBT has shared the supporting on-chain data with the Hyperliquid team. — link

Bitwise: Ethereum Staking Hits Record 43.8M ETH, Accounting for 35.9% of Total Supply, Up for Sixth Consecutive Quarter Bitwise's Q4 2026 Staking Report shows that Ethereum staking reached an all-time high of 43.8 million ETH, representing 35.9% of total supply and marking six consecutive quarters of growth. Ethereum's staking yield declined from 2.81% to 2.63%. Solana's staking ratio stood at 69%, with yields falling from 6.38% to 5.99%, while NEAR's staking ratio reached 46%, with a yield of 4.87%. The report also highlighted that tokenized stock trading volume on Solana rose 45% to $6.93 billion, while daily tokenized stock trading volume on Robinhood Chain increased 22-fold during the quarter. — link
